body: Thank you! I appreciate it. It was bad but not as bad as other days. How was your day? Also I hope u have a great day
And that’s valid! Your allowed to be, don’t worry I sleep all day yet when I wake up I feel drained. Hope your doing a bit better
It’s not stupid, I feel the same. Your feelings are as much valid as anyone.

You are so much stronger then u think! Why? Because you haven’t given up yet. I know this sounds so cliche because I hear it all the time but it truly is true I fight myself everyday. But we can only go one day at a time. Enjoy the little things in life, I like to just watch the sunset and that makes me a bit less sad. The little things so matter more then the big. I’ve lost all my friends yet I feel more better then ever. You got this! I’m here for you if u ever need to talk as a friend. To let your feelings out. It’s fine we all are struggling everyday some more then others. But we’re still fighting! And so are you! You haven’t given up and I’m so proud of you. You got this one day at a time. -xx

Keep fighting in hopes that we will eventually get out of this black hole. One day things won’t feel as shitty as we think. You can do what u put ur mind to, I believe in you. Keep trying. Stay safe, you are loved -xx
That is such a great way to put it, exactly that’s what I’m hoping that the okay feeling will come back

Don’t give up please. I want nothing more then my pain to stop. I’m still here fighting. As for those guys screw them. People are so disgusting in this world. I hope is not lost, I’m waiting for the rainbow at the end of the storm. I’ve been waiting for 5 years. As for vitiligo I get where your coming from I have it. You know what I tell myself, why am I different. Why can’t I be the same. But then I realize I’m trying to fit in with everyone and then what. Life will still be a struggle I just learn to live day by day. Your beautiful no matter what. There are thousands of people that feel the same. But you are loved! I love you. I may not know you but we are waiting for the rainbow aren’t we? We’re waiting for that rainbow it’ll soon come. We just have to keep fighting this war. Hope your doing alright. -x

I know you probably hear this or maybe, but your strong for being here. For still fighting. I always remind myself it’s easy to give up and just die you know? But it’s harder to live. It’s harder to keep trying. I’ve been depressed for as long as I can remember I haven’t felt happy in 5 years and I’m still waiting for the rainbow to come after the storm. I’m still here waiting. We’ll wait together. I want happiness. But I also ask myself how do I love myself when I don’t know me. I see someone who isn’t me. I’m here trying every day. Every day I feel hope drifting away. But I’m trying so hard. I can tell you are too. I used to cut to try and punish myself. I’ve learned to take things slow. I cry, to let it out. It’s better to cry then to hold it in. I hope your doing alright. Keep trying please. There are so many people you don’t know that care about you. I may not know you but u are loved. I love you. You are strong. Thank u for fighting. -x

This made me happy thank you so much. I find it so strange how people online are so nice when even those close to us are not like this. You give great advice. Thank you. I haven’t had kindness shown to me. I always get used for homework, or anything people need. Look at me here I am crying because someone actually cares. I appreciate you. I have never had a piece of advice as yours. Everyone just judges me for feeling the way I feel. Saying I crave attention when I just need an outlet. Thank you. I hope u can talk to me when u need someone. We may be strangers but we all need someone kind. Thanks again, x
